description: This file is a Java test class that verifies the conversion of ImmutableThing objects to JSON, especially in cases where the schema version differs from the creation version. It contains multiple test methods performing different conversions and assertions.

classes.name: ImmutableThingToJsonVersionMismatchTest
classes.description: A final test class containing unit tests for converting ImmutableThing objects to JSON with different schema versions.

methods.name: convertThingV1ToJsonWithDefaultFieldsV2
methods.description: Tests converting a version 1 ImmutableThing to JSON with default fields, expecting certain fields to be removed.

methods.name: convertThingV1ToJsonWithAllFieldsV2
methods.description: Tests converting a version 1 ImmutableThing to JSON including all fields, adjusting JSON version appropriately.

methods.name: convertThingV2ToJsonWithDefaultFieldsV1
methods.description: Tests converting a version 2 ImmutableThing to JSON with schema version V_1, expecting certain fields to be added or removed.

methods.name: convertThingV2ToJsonWithAllFieldsV1
methods.description: Tests converting a version 2 ImmutableThing to JSON with all fields included and schema version set to V_1.

methods.name: assertJsonEquals
methods.description: Helper method for asserting that two JsonObjects are equal, ignoring field definitions.
